infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NoteSnap uses your microphone to identify music playing around you, and to listen to your take while you film your own practice.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NoteSnap uses your camera to scan sheet music pages into your library, and to film your own practice with sound.

plugins.cameraPermission: NoteSnap uses your camera to scan sheet music pages into your library, and to film your own practice with sound.

plugins.calendarPermission: NoteSnap adds one daily practice reminder to your calendar when you ask it to. It only ever creates, updates or removes that one NoteSnap event.
plugins.remindersPermission: NoteSnap does not use your reminders.
